NONE: B1 used to emphasize how surprised, angry, shocked, etc. you are
（驚奇、憤怒或震驚時用於加強語氣）（我的）天哪！

example: Oh my God, I've never seen anything like it!
我的天哪，我從沒有見過那樣的事情！

NONE: › used when you have just remembered something that you were saying
（用於表示剛想起某事）對了，想起來了

example: What was I talking about - oh yes, I was telling you what happened at the party.
我剛在說甚麼——哦，對了，我正告訴你聚會上發生的事情。

NONE: › used to express surprise, shock, or worry

example: Oh Lord! I've forgotten the tickets!
Good Lord! Is that the time?
